snippet.title: SHOPPING NIGHTMARES | Announcement trailer
snippet.description:
Shopping Nightmares is a top-down survival horror game. Step into the shoes of an unknown investigator as he is trapped in a dimension known as "The Negative". Fend off enemies, manage your limited resources and discover the secrets of The Negative and its parasite.

GameJolt page: https://gamejolt.com/games/ShoppingNightmares/1015270

Steam page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4075020/Shopping_Nightmares/
